title: SearchLocate
description: `GET /search/files`: the locator behind Quick Open and the @ of the composer — paths and directories of an open folder, fuzzy-matched and ranked (plan 11, B-09).

path.description: Relative to the open folder, with /.

positions.description: Ascending indices into path, for the client to highlight. Empty for an unscored prefer entry.

skipped.description: Paths ripgrep returned that this backend could not decode as UTF-8 — omitted from entries, never garbled into one (S-63).
